basic_info.main_problem: I have a persistent belief that I will be alone forever, despite having a lot of friends. This belief is causing feelings of loneliness and inadequacy. The problem started around a year ago when I faced several rejections in the dating scene.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are impacting my emotional well-being and self-esteem.
growth_experiences: About a year ago, experiencing repeated rejections in blind dates/dating, described as 'a string of failures'; since then, repeatedly triggering the thought 'I will always be Single' when Being alone or Seeing couples; despite Having a supportive circle of friends, not yet confiding in friends due to fear of being judged, these experiences gradually Reinforced Loneliness and inferiority.

core_beliefs: I am destined to be Loneliness/nobody will choose me
Something is wrong with me/not good enough, not worthy of being loved

special_situations.event: Being alone at night, when thinking about one's romantic future
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If nobody is willing to date me for a long time, it means I will never find a partner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers expectations by presuming the worst outcome in advance ('it is destined to be so'), to reduce the pain of being rejected again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always be Single, this can no longer be changed

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others all have partners but I do not, then it means I am inferior to them/I am not needed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compares self with others and belittles self, avoiding proactive contact to escape further setbacks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Others can all have intimate relationships, only I cannot

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If this fails, the future will keep failing too; one rejection proves I am not worthy of being loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shifts energy toward confirming the 'destined to fail' thought, reduces attempts to avoid further setbacks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Rejected again, I will never find anyone

special_situations.event: When thinking about confiding Loneliness and frustrating experiences to friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose vulnerability, they will look down on me, thinking I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids expressing to friends, keeps feelings bottled up to avoid possible judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am a failure, will look down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and to build a stable intimate relationship, to gain love and understanding
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, being judged as a failure, suffering humiliation or negation after exposing vulnerability
defense_goal: Through self-deprecation and presetting 'destined to fail', lowers expectations and avoids the pain of rejection
Maintaining emotional defenses and non-disclosure, reducing the risk of external judgment

object_relations.self_representation: a rejected failure/a person not chosen
object_relations.object_representation: Others (potential partners/friends) are critical judges and rejecters

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor inquires whether he can share Loneliness and frustration with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believing that once vulnerability is expressed, friends will look down on oneself (like outside judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Express concerns in a hesitant tone, worried about being judged, emphasizing 'they will look down on me', avoiding further open self-disclosure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing experiences of repeated rejection and future possibilities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Using 'fate' to Interpretation failure, to reduce inner conflict and helplessness
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use generalized, fatalistic expressions (such as 'it may just be fate'), tone carrying helplessness, thus weakening further exploration of specific details.

manifestations: Continuously believing 'I will always be Single'
When Seeing couples or Being alone at night, Loneliness and despair markedly intensified
Fearing judgment and not seeking help from supportive friends, leading to keeping emotional distance from others
outcomes: Avoids expressing needs, further weakening connection and support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Worrying about being judged by friends as a 'failure', unwilling to express Loneliness and ask for help
Highly cautious about self-disclosure in relationships, tending to Repress needs

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Assuming friends will look down on oneself, disappointed in oneself, thus avoiding contact and expression
Projecting inner shame and self-denigration as others negating oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to perform some action toward other people or things, and does it to themselves instead, drawing the energy inward.
manifestations: Having supportive friends but not seeking support, digesting pain by oneself
When needing external help, choosing endurance and self-Repression

positive_force: Has a supportive circle of friends; has the ability to maintain friendships
Willing to engage in counseling and try reality testing and cognitive restructuring
Able to self-Reflect, identifying the role of Fear of rejection in relationships
negative_force: Catastrophizing and predicting the future ('I will always be Single')
Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking (one rejection equals permanent failure)
Mental filtering and negating the positive, ignoring existing interpersonal connection strengths
Afraid of being judged and so avoids expressing needs to friends, reducing available support
Self-deprecation and fatalism increasing helplessness and avoidance behaviors

antecedent: Thinking about the future when Being alone at night
After being rejected on a date
target_behavior.core_reason: A year of consecutive rejection experiences Reinforced overgeneralizing and catastrophizing cognitive processing, forming negative core assumptions about future relationships
target_behavior.function: By assuming the worst outcome to avoid uncertainty and the pain of being rejected again (emotional negative Reinforcement)
target_behavior.consequence: Worsened Loneliness and hopelessness, Impaired self-esteem, reduced attempts and self-disclosure, maintaining the problem cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expressing Loneliness to friends and seeking support
antecedent: Thinking about discussing one's setbacks and Loneliness with friends
Facing strong worry about being rejected or judged
